independent_sympy_reconstruction.scope: Exact 16x16 Pauli-product reconstruction and restriction; no producer implementation imported
independent_sympy_reconstruction.reproduction_code:
from sympy import Matrix, I, Rational, kronecker_product as kp, zeros, eye
from itertools import permutations
sx=Matrix([[0,1],[1,0]])/2
sy=Matrix([[0,-I],[I,0]])/2
sz=Matrix([[1,0],[0,-1]])/2
sp=[sx,sy,sz]
def eps(p):
    return (-1)**sum(p[i]>p[j] for i in range(3) for j in range(i+1,3))
Q=zeros(16)
for p in permutations(range(3)):
    Q+=eps(p)*kp(sp[p[0]],sp[p[1]],sp[p[2]],eye(2))
u0=zeros(16,1);u1=zeros(16,1)
for bits,a,b in [('0101',Rational(1,2),Rational(-1,2)),('0110',Rational(-1,2),Rational(-1,2)),('1001',Rational(-1,2),Rational(-1,2)),('1010',Rational(1,2),Rational(-1,2)),('0011',0,1),('1100',0,1)]:
    u0[int(bits,2)]=a;u1[int(bits,2)]=b
B=Matrix.hstack(u0,u1);G=B.H*B;M=G.inv()*B.H*Q*B
assert G==Matrix([[1,0],[0,3]])
assert M==Matrix([[0,-3*I/4],[I/4,0]])
assert M*M==eye(2)*Rational(3,16)
assert M.H*G-G*M==zeros(2)
assert Q*B==B*M
assert Q.H==Q
print('Exact SymPy reconstruction passed')
